title: Érdeklődés és közvetett kérdések (Indirect Questions & The -e Particle)
grammar: Indirect Polar Questions with -e & Embedded Wh-Questions in Hungarian

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can report a yes/no question with hogy … -e.
I can report a question with a question word, without -e.
I can name inquiry, interest and information in Hungarian.
I can say what orientation and information mean.
